relay_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the SMTP relay server (e.g., smtp.example.com)

relay_port.description: Port number of the SMTP relay server (commonly 25, 465, or 587)

use_tls.description: Whether to use TLS encryption for the connection (if supported by the relay)

use_starttls.description: Whether to use STARTTLS upgrade (for port 25/587). Ignored if use_tls=true on port 465.

tls_trust_file.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for TLS verification (empty to disable verification)

use_auth.description: Whether to authenticate to the SMTP relay (e.g., with username/password)

auth_user.description: Username for SMTP authentication (required only if use_auth=true)

auth_password.description: Password for SMTP authentication (required only if use_auth=true). Consider using .netrc for security.

default_from.description: Default 'From' address used when sending mail (if not specified by the client)

log_file.description: Path to log file for debugging and monitoring (empty string disables logging)

sendmail_path.description: Path to the sendmail wrapper script (used when msmtp is invoked via sendmail interface)
